china-1914:p0280_1.rationale: Mail items received by district and category (letters, postcards, newspapers and printed matter) are postal traffic.

china-1914:p0282_1.rationale: Ordinary letters and postcards dispatched by postal district.

china-1914:p0283_1.rationale: Items dispatched by category (newspapers, samples, registered articles, free correspondence) and totals by office.

china-1914:p0287_1.rationale: Money orders cashed with surplus and deficit by district for two years; postal money-order transactions.
